functionalRequirement: User will choose from options including searching for their issue, chatting with customer support, asking the community, emailing customer support, or calling customer support.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Appropriateness Recognizability: The system must clearly label each support option with a distinct and easily understandable icon or text.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires users to easily identify and choose from multiple support options, which enhances user experience.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Learnability: The system must provide a brief tooltip or help text for each support option, explaining what the option does and when to use it.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves multiple support options, and users should be able to quickly understand how to use each one.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The system must ensure that all support options are accessible via a single click or tap, with no more than two additional steps required to initiate the chosen support method.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR aims to provide quick access to support, which should be easy to operate for all users.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must ensure that all support options are available 99.9% of the time during business hours.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires continuous availability of support options to ensure users can always access help when needed.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must encrypt all user communications with customer support using TLS 1.3.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user communications, which should be protected to ensure privacy and security.

functionalRequirement: The system shall be able to grant edit permissions for assets to departmental administrators, inventory users, faculty users, and university users based on their department affiliation and authorization level.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must support all specified user roles (departmental administrators, inventory users, faculty users, and university users) and their respective authorization levels for asset editing.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to handle specific user roles and their permissions, ensuring full functional coverage.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must accurately enforce the specified authorization levels, ensuring that only users with the correct permissions can edit assets.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves role-based access control, which must be implemented correctly to maintain data integrity.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: The system must log all asset edit actions, including the user ID, timestamp, and changes made, to ensure auditability and traceability.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves sensitive operations (asset editing), and logging is essential for maintaining data integrity and accountability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Modifiability: The system must allow for easy updates to user roles and authorization levels without requiring code changes, using a configuration file or database.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires flexibility in managing user roles and permissions, which should be easily modifiable to adapt to changing organizational needs.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Scalability: The system must support up to 1,000 concurrent users performing asset edit actions without degradation in performance.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves multiple users and roles, and the system should be scalable to handle a growing user base.

functionalRequirement: Texts sent to that number will be sent to the API, then the system will reply to the user with the answer as another text message.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must process and respond to text messages within 5 seconds of receipt.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time communication, and timely responses are critical for user satisfaction.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Resource Utilization: The system must handle up to 100 concurrent text message requests without exceeding 200 MB of memory usage.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves handling multiple text messages, and efficient resource use is necessary for scalability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must encrypt all text message data in transit using TLS 1.3 and store any sensitive information (e.g., user IDs) using AES-256 encryption.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user communications, which should be protected to ensure privacy and security.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Fault Tolerance: The system must be able to handle and log any errors during text message processing, ensuring that the system can recover and retry failed messages.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves critical user communications, and the system should be resilient to errors to ensure reliability.

functionalRequirement: After adding a transportation route, the user shall be able to retrieve transportation requests from other users.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must retrieve and display transportation requests within 2 seconds of the user's request.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time data retrieval, and quick responses are essential for user satisfaction.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Resource Utilization: The system must handle up to 500 concurrent requests for transportation data without exceeding 100 MB of memory usage.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves handling multiple user requests, and efficient resource use is necessary for scalability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The system must provide a clear and intuitive interface for users to filter and sort transportation requests based on relevant criteria (e.g., date, location, status).
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires users to interact with transportation requests, and a user-friendly interface is essential for usability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must ensure that only authorized users can view transportation requests, with access controlled based on user roles and permissions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves sensitive user data, and access should be restricted to authorized users to ensure privacy.

functionalRequirement: The Disputes System shall allow users to create charge back requests, prompting for required information and resulting in printed notifications sent to merchants if proof of disputed transactions is not provided.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must capture all required information for a charge back request, including transaction details, user ID, and any supporting documentation.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to handle all necessary data for charge back requests, ensuring full functional coverage.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must validate all required information before allowing the user to submit a charge back request, ensuring that all fields are correctly filled out.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves critical financial transactions, and data validation is essential to prevent errors.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must process and generate printed notifications within 10 minutes of the charge back request being submitted.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves timely communication with merchants, and quick processing is necessary to maintain trust and efficiency.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must encrypt all charge back request data, including transaction details and user information, using AES-256 encryption.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves sensitive financial data, and strong encryption is necessary to protect user information.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Recoverability: The system must have a backup and recovery mechanism to ensure that charge back requests and their status can be restored in case of system failure.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves critical financial transactions, and the system should be able to recover from failures to ensure data integrity.
